CustomObject.label: Expert
CustomObject.description: Prototype-only data source for the "Schedule Expert Call" AI suggestion feature in the Salesforce-in-Teams record page: who's an expert in what, and their (free-text, not calendar-backed) available slots. Not the real expert-matching model discussed earlier (that would use Skill/SkillUser/Case_Skill__c, blocked on SkillUser being empty) - this is a deliberately simple, standalone object built specifically to unblock a working AI-suggestion demo now.
